title: ask_followup
description: Ask a follow-up question about the answer the candidate just gave. Use to probe a vague, shallow, or unusually interesting answer. Optional fields accept null: the model emits null to mean 'no preference', and rejecting that spends a repair turn on a call that was not actually wrong. Required fields stay strict, where a null IS a mistake worth correcting.

rationale.description: Why this probe, in one sentence.

parentQuestionId.description: The questionId returned by the fetch_question call this follows up on.
